class.name: ScriptTestRunner
class.brief_description: Base class for project test runner scripts hosted by the engine CLI.
class.description: Extend [ScriptTestRunner] to implement a project-local test entrypoint. The engine launches the script under a live [SceneTree] main loop via [code]foundry project test[/code], passes user arguments after [code]--[/code] to [method run], and exits the process with the integer returned by [method run]. Async [method run] implementations are supported: the host awaits the coroutine handle and uses the completed result as the process exit code.

method.name: run
method.description: Script-dispatched entrypoint for project test runners. [param args] contains the user arguments from [code]OS.get_cmdline_user_args()[/code], in order. Return the desired process exit code. Async overrides are allowed. Example CLI: [codeblock] foundry --headless project test --project . --runner res://addons/foundrylib/testlib/cli/run.fs -- --path res://tests --filter inventory [/codeblock]
